verdict.rationale: Svelte documents an online playground for trying code (svelte-docs-45) and a CLI path from a playground URL to a full project (svelte-docs-15). A hands-on user praises the interactive tutorial with sandboxes (svelte-comm-17), and another notes the docs include lots of examples (svelte-comm-7). However, nothing shows that the API reference itself is interactive or that its entries embed runnable examples; the runnable surfaces are the playground and tutorial, beside the reference. Missing for 10: an API reference with inline runnable or editable examples, documentation of how reference entries link to the playground, and independent corroboration of an interactive reference experience.
